literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the renyin day, Du Ji, Advisory Aide on the Staff of the General Who Punishes the Barbarians, was made Governor of Qing Province.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the renyin day, Du Ji, advisory aide on the staff of the General Who Punishes the Barbarians, was appointed Governor of Qing Province.

literal: On the renzi day, Empress Yuan of the Yuan clan died.
idiomatic: On the renzi day, Empress Yuan, née Yuan, died.

literal: In the eighth month, Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji provinces suffered great floods; on the jiwei day, envoys were sent to inspect the damage and grant relief.
idiomatic: In the eighth month, Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji provinces suffered severe flooding; on the jiwei day, envoys were sent to inspect the affected districts and provide relief.

literal: On the renzi day of the ninth month, Empress Yuan was buried at the Changning Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On the renzi day of the ninth month, Empress Yuan was buried at the Changning Mausoleum.

literal: On the wuwu day in the tenth month of winter, Liu Zhan, former Intendant of Danyang, was guilty of a crime; he and his accomplices were executed.
idiomatic: On the wuwu day in the tenth month of winter, Liu Zhan, former Intendant of Danyang, was found guilty of a crime; he and his accomplices were put to death.

literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm; civil and military officials were granted one rank of nobility.
idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and civil and military officials were granted one rank of nobility.

literal: Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, Grand General, concurrent Minister over the Masses, Recorder of the Masters of Writing, and Governor of Yang Province, was made Governor of Jiang Province, Grand General as before.
idiomatic: Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, Grand General, concurrent Minister over the Masses, Recorder of the Masters of Writing, and Governor of Yang Province, was reassigned as Governor of Jiang Province, retaining the title of Grand General.

literal: Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Minister of Works and Governor of Southern Yan Province, was made Minister over the Masses and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing.
idiomatic: Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, Minister of Works and Governor of Southern Yan Province, became Minister over the Masses and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters of Writing.

literal: On the wuyin day, Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, General of the Guard, was made Governor of Southern Yan Province with his original title; Yin Jingren, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army, was made Governor of Yang Province, Vice Director as before.
idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, General of the Guard, was appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province while keeping his original title; Yin Jingren, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army, became Governor of Yang Province and retained his post as Vice Director.

literal: On the bingxu day, Liu Yirong of the Masters of Writing was made General Who Leads the Army; Xu Pazhi, Supervisor of the Secretariat, was made General of the Guard.
idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Liu Yirong of the Masters of Writing was appointed General Who Leads the Army, and Xu Pazhi, Supervisor of the Secretariat, was appointed General of the Guard.

literal: On the dinghai day, an edict said: "The grain and seed previously given to the people of Yang and Southern Xu provinces for their fields, and the rent-grain from Yan, the two Yu provinces, Qing, and Xu that in recent years was leniently assessed and should be levied in arrears—all are remitted by half.
idiomatic: On the dinghai day, an edict said: "The field grain and seed previously distributed to the people of Yang and Southern Xu provinces, together with the rent-grain from Yan, the two Yu provinces, Qing, and Xu that in recent years was assessed leniently and ought now to be collected in arrears, are all to be remitted by half.

literal: Where there is no harvest this year, [21] all is remitted in full.
idiomatic: Where there is no harvest this year, [21] the levy is to be remitted in full.

literal: All overdue debts are to be assessed leniently and reduced.
idiomatic: All overdue debts are to be leniently assessed and reduced.

literal: Moreover, the estimated taxes of the provinces and commanderies, and the market levies at each place, are in many cases burdensome and harsh.
idiomatic: Moreover, the estimated taxes of the provinces and commanderies and the market levies imposed locally are in many cases burdensome and harsh.

literal: The profits of mountains and marshes are still in some places forbidden and cut off;
idiomatic: The profits from mountains and marshes are still in some places forbidden and monopolized;

literal: and the categories of labor corvée extend even to the very young.
idiomatic: and the categories of labor corvée extend even to children.

literal: Matters such as these harm governance and injure the people.
idiomatic: Matters such as these harm good governance and injure the people.

literal: From now on let all be in accordance with law and statute, and strive to give full lenience and relief.
idiomatic: From now on let everything conform to law and statute, and strive to grant full lenience and relief.

literal: If there is anything inconvenient, report it separately according to the matter; one must not hastily pursue momentary gain in contravention of the purpose of hidden care and relief.
idiomatic: If anything proves inconvenient, report it separately on its merits; one must not hastily pursue momentary revenue in contravention of the purpose of compassionate relief.

literal: Responsible officials shall clearly proclaim this below, expressing my intent."
idiomatic: Responsible officials shall clearly proclaim this throughout the realm, in accord with my intent."

literal: On the guichou day, Yin Jingren, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Governor of Yang Province, died.
idiomatic: On the guichou day, Yin Jingren, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and Governor of Yang Province, died.

literal: On the guihai day of the twelfth month, Wang Qiu, Grandee of Splendid Virtue, was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
idiomatic: On the guihai day of the twelfth month, Wang Qiu, Grandee of Splendid Virtue, was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

literal: [22] On the wuchen day, Prince of Shixing Jun was made Governor of Yang Province; Prince of Wuling Jun was made Governor of Southern Yu Province; Prince of Nanping Shuo was made Governor of Xiang Province.
idiomatic: [22] On the wuchen day, Prince of Shixing Jun was appointed Governor of Yang Province; Prince of Wuling Jun became Governor of Southern Yu Province; and Prince of Nanping Shuo became Governor of Xiang Province.

literal: That year, the King of Wudu, the King of Henan, and Paekche sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
idiomatic: That year, the King of Wudu, the King of Henan, and Paekche sent envoys bearing local products as tribute.

literal: In the second month of spring of the eighteenth year, on the yimao day, Yu Dengzhi, Administrator of Yuzhang, was made Governor of Jiang Province.
idiomatic: In the second month of spring of the eighteenth year, on the yimao day, Yu Dengzhi, Administrator of Yuzhang, was appointed Governor of Jiang Province.

literal: On the renwu day in the fifth month of summer, [23] Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, General of the Guard and Governor of Southern Yan Province, and Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, General Who Campaigns against the North and Governor of Southern Xu Province, were both granted the privilege of Opening the Headquarters with ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: On the renwu day in the fifth month of summer, [23] Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, General of the Guard and Governor of Southern Yan Province, and Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, General Who Campaigns against the North and Governor of Southern Xu Province, were both granted the privilege of Opening the Headquarters with ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies.

literal: On the guisi day, the commandery of Songxi was established in Jiao Province.
idiomatic: On the guisi day, the commandery of Songxi was established in Jiao Province.

literal: That month, the Han River overflowed.
idiomatic: That month, the Han River overflowed its banks.

literal: On the wuchen day of the sixth month, envoys were sent to tour the districts and grant famine relief.
idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the sixth month, envoys were sent to tour the districts and provide famine relief.

literal: On the xinwei day, Liu Yirong, General Who Leads the Army, died.
idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Liu Yirong, General Who Leads the Army, died.

literal: On the wuxu day of the seventh month of autumn, Zhao Bofu, Governor of Xu and Yan provinces, was made General Who Leads the Army.
idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the seventh month of autumn, Zhao Bofu, Governor of Xu and Yan provinces, was appointed General Who Leads the Army.

literal: On the xinhai day in the tenth month of winter, Zang Zhi, Administrator of the two commanderies of Badong and Jianping, was made Governor of Xu and Yan provinces.
idiomatic: On the xinhai day in the tenth month of winter, Zang Zhi, Administrator of Badong and Jianping commanderies, was appointed Governor of Xu and Yan provinces.

literal: On the yimao day, the commanderies of Nanyan, Puyang, and Nanguangping in Southern Xu Province were abolished.
idiomatic: On the yimao day, the commanderies of Nanyan, Puyang, and Nanguangping in Southern Xu Province were abolished.

literal: On the wuzi day of the eleventh month, Wang Qiu, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, died.
idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the eleventh month, Wang Qiu, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, died.

literal: [24] On the jihai day, Meng Yen, Intendant of Danyang, was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
idiomatic: [24] On the jihai day, Meng Yen, Intendant of Danyang, was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

literal: Yang Nandang of the Di again raided the Han River region.
idiomatic: Yang Nandang of the Di again raided the Han River region.

literal: On the guihai day of the twelfth month, General of Dragon Celerity Pei Fangming and Liu Zhendao, Governor of Liang and Qin provinces, were dispatched to attack him.
idiomatic: On the guihai day of the twelfth month, Pei Fangming, General of Dragon Celerity, and Liu Zhendao, Governor of Liang and Qin provinces, were dispatched to attack him.

literal: That month, [25] Zan Songzi, Administrator of Jinning, rebelled; Xu Xun, Governor of Ning Province, attacked and pacified him.
idiomatic: That month, [25] Zan Songzi, Administrator of Jinning, rebelled; Xu Xun, Governor of Ning Province, attacked and suppressed him.

literal: That year, the state of Sute, Koguryo, Sumili, and Lin-yi all sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
idiomatic: That year, Sute, Koguryo, Sumili, and Lin-yi all sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

literal: In the first month of the nineteenth year, on the yisi day, an edict said: "What one relies upon is the root—the remote teachings of the sages;
idiomatic: In the first month of the nineteenth year, on the yisi day, an edict said: "What one relies upon is the root—the far-reaching teachings of the sages;

literal: when the root is established, transformation and cultivation follow; instruction and learning are what is prized.
idiomatic: when the root is established, transformation and cultivation follow, and instruction and learning are what is prized.

literal: Hence they were admonished with the three virtues and honored with the four arts, thereby able to receive all into the paths of righteousness and bring them to measure and rule.
idiomatic: Hence the ancients were admonished with the three virtues and honored with the four arts, thereby able to bring all within the paths of righteousness and lead them to proper measure.

literal: In flourishing kings and sage ages, [26] all necessarily followed this path.
idiomatic: In ages of flourishing kings and sage rulers, [26] all necessarily followed this path.

literal: At the reception of the mandate in Yongchu, the constitution and statutes were broad and far-reaching; we were to mold the myriad classes and unify distinct customs; there was an edict to the responsible offices to broadly open the schools, but we repeatedly encountered hardship and disorder and did not reach completion of construction.
idiomatic: At the reception of the mandate in Yongchu, the constitution and statutes were broad and far-reaching; the court was to mold the myriad people and unify distinct customs, and an edict ordered the responsible offices to open schools on a grand scale, yet repeated hardship and disorder prevented their completion.

literal: Eternally gazing upon the former design, I think to spread the great achievement.
idiomatic: Ever gazing upon the designs of former ages, I wish to spread this great achievement.

literal: Now the four quarters are at peace; barbarian and Chinese alike look with admiration; broadly to instruct the sons of the ruling house is truly the task of the age.
idiomatic: Now the four quarters are at peace, and barbarians and Chinese alike look to the court with admiration; broadly to instruct the imperial scions is truly the task of the age.

literal: Let there now be modeled upon the established regulations and the brilliant enterprise propagated."
idiomatic: Let the court now model itself on the established regulations and propagate this brilliant enterprise."

literal: On the jiaxu day in the fourth month of summer, because his long illness had ended, he for the first time offered the yue sacrifice, [27] and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
idiomatic: On the jiaxu day in the fourth month of summer, because his long illness had ended, he for the first time offered the year-end yue sacrifice, [27] and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

literal: On the gengyin day of the fifth month, Liu Zhendao, Governor of Liang and Qin provinces, and Pei Fangming, General of Dragon Celerity, defeated Yang Nandang of the Di; Qiuchi was pacified.
idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the fifth month, Liu Zhendao, Governor of Liang and Qin provinces, and Pei Fangming, General of Dragon Celerity, defeated Yang Nandang of the Di, and Qiuchi was pacified.

literal: In the intercalary month, rain fell in the capital;
idiomatic: In the intercalary month, rain fell heavily in the capital;

literal: on the dingsi day, envoys were sent to tour the districts and grant relief.
idiomatic: on the dingsi day, envoys were sent to tour the districts and provide relief.

literal: On the renwu day of the sixth month, Juqu Wuhui was made General Who Campaigns against the West and Governor of Liang Province.
idiomatic: On the renwu day of the sixth month, Juqu Wuhui was appointed General Who Campaigns against the West and Governor of Liang Province.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn, Liu Zhendao, Governor of Liang and Qin provinces, was made Governor of Yong Province; Pei Fangming, General of Dragon Celerity, was made Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, Liu Zhendao, Governor of Liang and Qin provinces, was appointed Governor of Yong Province; Pei Fangming, General of Dragon Celerity, became Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.

literal: On the last day of the jiaxu cycle, the last day of the month, there was an eclipse of the sun.
idiomatic: On the last day of the month, the jiaxu day, there was a solar eclipse.

literal: On the jiashen day in the tenth month of winter, Rouran sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
idiomatic: On the jiashen day in the tenth month of winter, Rouran sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

literal: On the bingchen day, Zhou Wansui, Administrator of Jinning, was made Governor of Ning Province.
idiomatic: On the bingchen day, Zhou Wansui, Administrator of Jinning, was appointed Governor of Ning Province.

literal: In the twelfth month, on the pingchen day, an edict said: "The sons of the ruling house are first gathered; scholarly pursuits are just rising.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the pingchen day, an edict said: "The imperial scions are first gathered together, and scholarly pursuits are just beginning to flourish.

literal: Since the subtle words were extinguished, nearly a thousand years have passed; stirred by the matter, I think of the men of old, and my heart is filled with feeling.
idiomatic: Since the subtle teachings were lost, nearly a thousand years have passed; stirred by this matter, I think of the men of old, and my heart is filled with emotion.

literal: The descendants of the Revered Sage may speedily deliberate succession to his line.
idiomatic: The descendants of the Revered Sage should speedily deliberate on who shall succeed his line.

literal: At the site of the former temple, a structure is to be specially built; according to former practice, supply sacrificial offerings and appoint an overseer; offerings in the four seasons.
idiomatic: At the site of the former temple, a hall is to be specially built; according to former practice, sacrificial provisions are to be supplied and an overseer appointed for offerings in the four seasons.

literal: Quequ in the past suffered from bandit turmoil; the school buildings lie ruined and destroyed; order is also given to Lu Commandery to restore the study halls and recruit students.
idiomatic: Quequ in the past suffered from bandit raids, and the school buildings lie in ruins; orders are also sent to Lu Commandery to restore the study halls and recruit students.

literal: Men of old who were worthy and wise, and even those who did a single good deed, still sometimes guarded their hill graves and forbade pasture upon them—how much more Confucius, whose virtue marked out all living people and whose achievement covered a hundred generations, yet whose tomb lies overgrown and the brambles are not cut!
idiomatic: Men of old who were worthy and wise, and even those who performed a single good deed, still sometimes guarded their hill tombs and forbade grazing upon them—how much more Confucius, whose virtue set the standard for all living people and whose achievement covered a hundred generations, yet whose grave lies waste and the brambles are not cut down!

literal: Several households beside the tomb may be remitted from levies, to take charge of sprinkling and sweeping.
idiomatic: Several households beside the tomb may be exempted from levies to take charge of sprinkling and sweeping.

literal: The subjects of Lu Commandery, Kong Ching and five other households, lived near Confucius's tomb; their labor service and tax levies were remitted, and they were supplied for sweeping and sprinkling, and six hundred pine and cypress trees were also planted.
idiomatic: Kong Ching of Lu Commandery and five other households living near Confucius's tomb were exempted from labor service and tax levies, supplied for sweeping and sprinkling, and six hundred pine and cypress trees were planted as well.

literal: That year, the state of Bohuang sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
idiomatic: That year, Bohuang sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

literal: In the first month of spring of the twentieth year, the Wanchun and Qianqiu gates were opened east and west of the palace city.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the twentieth year, the Wanchun and Qianqiu gates were opened on the east and west sides of the palace city.

literal: On the jiaxu day, Yu Dengzhi, Governor of Jiang Province, was made General of the Guard.
idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, Yu Dengzhi, Governor of Jiang Province, was appointed General of the Guard.

literal: On the gengshen day, [28] Prince of Luling Shao was made Governor of Jiang Province.
idiomatic: On the gengshen day, [28] Prince of Luling Shao was appointed Governor of Jiang Province.

literal: Qiuchi was overrun by the Suo.
idiomatic: Qiuchi was overrun by the Suo.

literal: On the jiashen day, the imperial carriage reviewed troops at Baixia.
idiomatic: On the jiashen day, the Emperor reviewed troops at Baixia.

literal: On the xinhai day of the third month, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Jing Province, was advanced in title to General Who Campaigns against the West.
idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the third month, Prince of Hengyang Yiji, General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Jing Province, was advanced to General Who Campaigns against the West.

literal: Shen Tan, Administrator of Brazil and Zitong commanderies, was made Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
idiomatic: Shen Tan, Administrator of Brazil and Zitong commanderies, was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.

literal: On the jiawu day in the fourth month of summer, the sixth imperial prince Tan was established as Prince of Guangling.
idiomatic: On the jiawu day in the fourth month of summer, the sixth imperial prince Tan was created Prince of Guangling.

literal: On the guichou day of the fifth month, Yu Dengzhi, General of the Guard, died.
idiomatic: On the guichou day of the fifth month, Yu Dengzhi, General of the Guard, died.

literal: On the guichou day of the seventh month of autumn, Yang Wende was made General Who Campaigns against the West and Governor of Northern Qin Province, and enfeoffed as Prince of Wudu.
idiomatic: On the guichou day of the seventh month of autumn, Yang Wende was appointed General Who Campaigns against the West and Governor of Northern Qin Province and enfeoffed as Prince of Wudu.

literal: On the xinyou day, Xiao Sihua, Colonel of Southern Man, was made Governor of Yong Province.
idiomatic: On the xinyou day, Xiao Sihua, Colonel of Southern Man, was appointed Governor of Yong Province.

literal: On the jiazi day, Liu Zhendao, former Governor of Yong Province, and Pei Fangming, Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces, were guilty of crimes; they were imprisoned and put to death.
idiomatic: On the jiazi day, Liu Zhendao, former Governor of Yong Province, and Pei Fangming, Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces, were found guilty of crimes; they were imprisoned and put to death.

literal: On the guiwei day of the eighth month, Tao Minzu, Commandant of Punishments, was made Governor of Guang Province.
idiomatic: On the guiwei day of the eighth month, Tao Minzu, Commandant of Punishments, was appointed Governor of Guang Province.

literal: On the gengwu day in the twelfth month of winter, Tan Hezhi, Administrator of Shixing, was made Governor of Chiao Province.
idiomatic: On the gengwu day in the twelfth month of winter, Tan Hezhi, Administrator of Shixing, was appointed Governor of Chiao Province.

literal: On the renwu day, an edict said: "The state takes the people as its root; the people take food as their heaven.
idiomatic: On the renwu day, an edict said: "The state takes the people as its root, and the people take food as their heaven.

literal: Thus if one man ceases sowing, hunger is sure to reach others.
idiomatic: Thus if one man ceases sowing, hunger is sure to reach others.

literal: When the granaries are full, ritual and propriety arise.
idiomatic: When the granaries are full, ritual and propriety arise.

literal: Of late the places under government have been destitute, and households have no stored grain.
idiomatic: Of late the districts under government have been destitute, and households have no grain in store.

literal: When tax and corvée fall unevenly for a time, the people harbor grief and distress;
idiomatic: When taxes and corvée fall unevenly for a time, the people harbor grief and distress;

literal: when the year is sometimes unproductive, sickness and want afflict house after house.
idiomatic: when the year is sometimes unproductive, sickness and want afflict household after household.

literal: This is truly because governmental virtue has not won trust, and so such evils have reached this point;
idiomatic: This is truly because governmental virtue has not won the people's trust, and so such evils have reached this point;

literal: yet it is also because plowing and sericulture have not been widely extended, and much of the land's profit has been left unused.
idiomatic: yet it is also because plowing and sericulture have not been widely extended, and much of the land's profit has been left unused.

literal: The prefects and governors have been slight in methods of transforming and guiding; the common people have forgotten the duty of diligent division of labor.
idiomatic: The prefects and governors have been remiss in methods of transforming and guiding the people; the common people have forgotten the duty of diligent labor.

literal: Speaking of broad relief, my mind is stirred whenever I reflect upon it.
idiomatic: When I speak of broad relief, my mind is stirred whenever I reflect upon it.

literal: Although regulations and orders have been issued repeatedly, in the end there has been no correction or encouragement; yet to sit and look for increase and growth—how can that be achieved?
idiomatic: Although regulations and orders have been issued repeatedly, in the end there has been no real correction or encouragement; yet to sit and expect growth and abundance—how can that be achieved?

literal: The responsible offices shall proclaim the old statutes and strive to enforce instruction fully.
idiomatic: The responsible offices shall proclaim the old statutes and strive to enforce agricultural instruction fully.

literal: All who wander and eat without fixed occupation are to be ordered to attach themselves to productive work; diligence and idleness are to be examined and verified, and rewards and punishments applied; ability and conduct are to be observed, and demotion and promotion strictly enforced.
idiomatic: All who wander and eat without fixed occupation are to be ordered to attach themselves to productive work; diligence and idleness are to be examined, and rewards and punishments applied; ability and conduct are to be observed, and demotion and promotion strictly enforced.

literal: In antiquity the ruler himself plowed the imperial fields and reverently supplied the sacrificial grain; looking up to the former kings, I think to follow their established model.
idiomatic: In antiquity the ruler himself plowed the imperial fields and reverently supplied the sacrificial grain; looking up to the former kings, I wish to follow their established model.

literal: Let a thousand mou be measured out and the auspicious day divined.
idiomatic: Let a thousand mou be measured out and the auspicious day divined.

literal: I shall personally lead the hundred officials to perform rites in the suburban fields, that sincerity and simplicity may in some measure reach the people."
idiomatic: I shall personally lead the hundred officials to perform rites in the suburban fields, that sincerity and simplicity may in some measure reach the people."

literal: That year, the Hexi state, Koguryo, Paekche, and Wa all sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
idiomatic: That year, Hexi, Koguryo, Paekche, and Wa all sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

literal: That year, many commanderies and provinces suffered flood and drought damaging the crops; the people suffered great famine.
idiomatic: That year, many commanderies and provinces suffered flood and drought that damaged the crops, and the people suffered great famine.

literal: Envoys were sent to open the granaries and grant relief, and grain and seed were distributed.
idiomatic: Envoys were sent to open the granaries and grant relief, and grain and seed were distributed.

literal: On the jihai day of the first month of spring of the twenty-first year, Southern Xu, Southern Yu, and the regions west of the Zhe River in Yang Province [29] were all prohibited from wine.
idiomatic: On the jihai day of the first month of spring of the twenty-first year, Southern Xu, Southern Yu, and the regions west of the Zhe River in Yang Province [29] were all prohibited from making wine.

literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
